concept.title: Plugins and Scripting Overview
concept.shortdesc: Two ways to extend OBS Studio beyond its built-in features.

conbody.p: Plugins are compiled extensions, installed alongside OBS Studio, that can add new source types, filters, or output methods. They're installed by copying files into the OBS plugins directory or through a platform-specific installer.
Scripts are Lua or Python files loaded from Tools > Scripts that can automate scene switching, respond to events, or add simple custom behavior without recompiling anything.
